clauses.title: CL-D75 records what a cleanup returns when the root it emptied stands
clauses.section: ## CL-D75 — A cleanup that cannot remove the root it emptied names it and still succeeds
requires: observed rather than inferred from the refusal
any use of it to sweep, expire, or report roots left by runs that never called cleanup, requires a new owner decision

clauses.title: The leftover run root is pinned by its own regression
requires: Issue #132 a root the cleanup emptied but could not remove is named, not claimed removed
Issue #132 a non-empty root refused by its parent is the same success, named the same way
Issue #132 the leftover is observed, not inferred from the refusal (CL-D75)
